<div class="card-body">
'''AT-AT Driver''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">AT－ATドライバー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">操縦する戦闘用ビークルの戦闘力に２を加える。戦闘用ビークルがＡＴ－ＡＴなら２ではなく３を加える。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-AT-AT-Driver-PSA-160326782.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">戦場を遥かに見下ろしつつウォーカーを駆るＡＴ－ＡＴドライバーたちは、厚さ15cmの強化装甲板で護られているため、歩兵たちからは臆病者と軽蔑されている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' AT-AT driver.

'''Card text:'''
Adds 2 to the power of a combat vehicle he pilots. Adds 3 instead of 2 if the combat vehicle is an AT-AT.

'''Lore:'''
AT-AT drivers who pilot walkers while looking down on the battlefield from far above are protected by 15 cm of reinforced armor, so the infantry despise them as cowards.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore says the infantry despise them as cowards.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[AT-AT Driver]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
